description: This file defines a struct 'TestBufferWriterStruct' that implements buffer writing interfaces for testing purposes within the Orleans.Serialization.TestKit namespace. It provides methods to access and manipulate a byte buffer, including getting memory, span, and read-only sequences.

classes.name: TestBufferWriterStruct
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> and IOutputBuffer for testing buffer writing operations.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> representing the buffer from the current write position.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> representing the buffer from the current write position.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> of the written buffer segment, batching with a specified maximum segment size.
